items.name: Marvisak/VIctory
items.description: An attempt at running GTA VI on PC
items.purpose: Dự án thử nghiệm chạy GTA VI trên máy tính PC

items.name: trustno1-coder/VIctory-NVIDIA
items.description: VIctory (Xbox Series compatibility layer) tuned for NVIDIA RTX cards: Series X at 2560x1440 with DLSS, about 26-30 fps on an RTX 5070, DLSS frame generation 2x-6x, an F1 settings menu and F3 stats panel, open water without dark blocks. Built on many repos combined into one. No game files or NVIDIA files included.
items.purpose: Lớp tương thích Xbox Series tối ưu cho card NVIDIA RTX để chơi game trên PC

items.name: fxceless/victory-fork
items.description: Work-in-progress fork of VIctory: getting an Xbox Series title to render and run on a Windows PC. No game files.
items.purpose: Bản fork thử nghiệm hỗ trợ chạy game Xbox Series trên máy tính Windows

items.name: ProjectLeonida/mandy

items.name: nexu-io/opengame

items.purpose: Nền tảng tạo và phát hành game 3D, mini-game bằng các agent AI

items.name: alesha-pro/llm.asm
items.description: Qwen3-0.6B inference (12 KB), bare-metal bootable OS (22 KB), and from-scratch Mini-GPT trainer with live Braille TUI (32 KB) in 100% pure x86-64 NASM assembly. Zero C, zero libc, zero dependencies.
items.purpose: Chương trình chạy suy luận và huấn luyện LLM bằng 100% ngôn ngữ Assembly
